tagline: Local STIHL dealer serving Taumarunui and the region
heroSubheading: Where Taumarunui comes for STIHL gear, servicing and expert advice.
aboutHtml:
We're the STIHL dealer in Taumarunui. Stephen and Joshua Gazjago run the shop and we stock the full range of STIHL power equipment built for the work people do around here.

We know what locals need. Whether you're clearing scrub, maintaining gardens, or tackling bigger jobs on the property, there's a STIHL machine for the task. We've got equipment in stock and ready to go. If you need advice, parts or a service, bring it to the workshop and we'll sort it out.

Come in Monday to Friday during business hours. We'll show you what's available, answer your questions about which model works best for your needs, and make sure you're set up right to get the job done.
